author: dev_revs
body:
Hello! In-game today, multiple players asked me some questions about tournaments and event-staff that had me scratching my head. When players come to the server, they don't know about tournaments and need to get introduced to them slowly but efficiently. I am making this post to hopefully fix those issues.

What does Official do?: The Official rank resembles the leaders of the tournaments. These people run/create tournaments, are in charge of the Referees and streamers, and manage anything that has to do with tournaments/competitive Avicus.

What are Tournaments?: Tournaments are events our Officials host. 8 players fight against another 8 in a specific gamemode, while competing to be the best and win some cool prizes!

How do I play in tournaments?:  If you are not currently on a team, you need to find one! Another second option is creating a team, but it may be hard to get enough players before registration closes. You can find all the teams looking for members, where you can apply right here. https://avicus.net/forums/categories/61. Also, check out the tournament discord where you can tell players you are looking for team. https://discord.gg/nqBCtkP . 

I am on a team, how do I play?: Let your team leader know about the tournament, he can sign up by going to https://avicus.net/tournaments, find the most recent tournament, click on "View" then at the bottom of the page click on the green "Register" Button. The leader must then manually invite the members of his team he wants to add to the roster. The players must accept the invite then, after invited.

I've complete all the steps above, what do I do now?: If any announcements happen, make sure you are in the tournament discord to see them. You also must be in that discord to play, any other questions can be asked there.

What does it mean to be "Tournament Blacklisted"?: Teams become tournament blacklisted by not following our tournaments rules, if your team gets blacklisted, you can no longer participate in tournaments. This may be appealed to the Official Team.


If you have any other questions, or things that should be added here, let me know via discord. 

Best regards,
The Avicus Official Team.
